notes: A different boss for every arena:
Sludge Queen (Toxic Dome): acid lobs, burning puddles, slimes
Cryo Sentinel (Frost Rink): ice spirals and charges; hit it while it's dazed
Magma Titan (Inferno): meteors and fire rings with a gap to slip through
Version number and these release notes show when the game opens
Updates install themselves between games, so you never lose a run
Power, pause and mute buttons moved beside the arena, out of the way
Pillar layouts you can use as cover
Round twists: Swarm, Ambush, Minefield, Lights Out and more
Zoomed bubble shows your guy when your thumb covers him
Nothing hidden behind the iPhone camera or home bar
